articles.title: AI-Native, Not AI-Sprinkle: Why AI Is A Business Change, Not A Technology Change
articles.description: Companies unlock AI’s biggest productivity gains not by adding AI tools to existing workflows, but by redesigning teams, roles and daily work around AI. articles.title: The Biggest Consequence Of An AI IPO Isn’t The IPO Itself. It’s What Happens Afterward.
